_comment: Fresh (post-G8, i.e. after commit ab8ba38/eeda789 removed the stale hardcoded vol_free table fallback) TS molecular C6 values, aug-cc-pVTZ and aug-cc-pVDZ, for every molecule in dosd (round 1) and dosd2 (round 2). Generated by re-running every *_ts.toml in scripts/dosd/runs and scripts/dosd2/runs against a release binary built from this worktree's HEAD (which includes G8). See docs/rpa-vs-ts-statistical-verdict.md for the full writeup of why this re-run was necessary (scripts/dosd/results.csv and scripts/dosd2/results.csv predate G8 and contain stale TS numbers for elements whose free-atom SCF hit the removed table fallback -- confirmed materially wrong for Si, S, Br; confirmed materially UNCHANGED for C/H/N/O/F/Cl/P/Ge, matching G7's finding that those elements' table entries happened to roughly agree with a live SCF).

_notes.o2: TS C6 hard-fails on both bases: pdep_polarizability_hirshfeld only supports closed-shell (Restricted) references, and dosd's gen_tomls.py sets c6_partition="hirshfeld" for all TS runs. O2 (triplet, UHF) cannot go through this path with the current codebase. dosd/results.csv's old O2 TS values (78.24 DZ / 54.12 TZ) are unreproducible with current code and are NOT used in the paired test. Reported as a finding, not fixed (out of scope for a benchmarking task).
_notes.hbr_augccpvtz: 241.426 a.u., cross-checked across two independent runs (241.426 both times). Br free-atom SCF at TZ needs a >300s timeout (~7-8 min observed); the 900s per-job budget in the final sweep covers it.
_notes.benzene_augccpvtz: 2073.411 a.u. (needs >300s -- 12-atom Becke/Hirshfeld grid, not a free-atom-volume issue; 900s budget covers it). Matches the old stale CSV value (2072.85) closely, confirming C/H-only molecules are not affected by the G8 fix.
_notes.br2_ch3br_geh4_augccpvtz: not used in the paired statistical test (dosd3 has no independent C6 reference for any molecule -- see consolidate.py). These three needed >300s (Br free-atom SCF at TZ) and were not re-run to completion given they don't feed the primary analysis; dosd3/results.md's existing pre-G8 numbers for these three are flagged stale in the writeup but not replaced, since they are only used as an internal RPA-vs-TS ratio, not a vs-reference error.
